When a school has more applicants than places in the later registration phases, MOE ranks them by citizenship and then by distance (within 1 km, then 1 to 2 km, then beyond 2 km), measured from the school boundary to the home address, so the bands here are approximate. A child can apply to any school; being nearby does not guarantee a place. Check MOE's P1 registration page and OneMap before relying on this.
